warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>,C2' — footing mark + the column stub C2 standing on it (C2 = 0.20x0.20, 6-DB12 on S-06). C2 is recorded here once (17 points); the floor-level columns are C1 on S-02 (same 17 points).
17 footings: row A at grids 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 (none at A4); row B only at B3, B5, B6 (the row-B beams at B1/B2 bear on beams, S-02); row C at C1, C2, C4, C6; row D at D2, D4, D6; row E at E2, E4.
F2 caps (two piles, 0.90 x 0.36 on S-05) are drawn with the 0.90 side along x, at C2, C4 and D4.

elements.note: ฐานรากเสาเข็ม 2 ต้น วางด้านยาว 0.90 ตามแนวแกน x
